Field.Name: CoManagedEntity
Field.Description: Self-Managed Entities have their own AAS. This is why a reference to this asset is specified as well (Entity/asset). Additionally, further property statements (compare to [15]) can be added to the asset that are not specified in the AAS of the asset itself because they are specified in relation to the complex I4.0 Component only.

Field.Name: SelfManagedEntity
Field.Description: For co-managed entities there is no separate AAS. The relationships and property statements of such entities are managed within the AAS of the composite I4.0 Component.

Value.uax:String: Provides detailed information and parameters related to the operational environment where the pick and place tasks are performed.
Specifies the default Cartesian point position of the Gripper within the workspace.
Specifies the position of the Gripper along the X-axis within the workspace, expressed in millimeters (mm).
Specifies the position of the Gripper along the Y-axis within the workspace, expressed in millimeters (mm).
Specifies the position of the Gripper along the Z-axis within the workspace, expressed in millimeters (mm).
Defines the spatial boundaries reachable by the end effector within the operating area of the device that performs "Pick and Place" operations.
Defines the maximum allowable boundary along the X-axis within the workspace, expressed in millimeters (mm). It sets the limit for the Gripper's movement in the X direction.
Defines the maximum allowable boundary along the Y-axis within the workspace, expressed in millimeters (mm). It sets the limit for the Gripper's movement in the Y direction.
Defines the maximum allowable boundary along the Z-axis within the workspace, expressed in millimeters (mm). It sets the limit for the Gripper's movement in the Z direction.
Provides all information related to asset positioning, including control parameters and positioning monitoring variables.
Defines the control parameters and actions for the pick and place device.

Indicates the current operational status of the Gripper, reflecting its state such as "Idle", "Active", "Error", or "Maintenance". This property can be used as a control parameter to initiate or halt actions.
Specifies the designated Cartesian coordinates where the Gripper is positioned to pick up an object within the workspace.
Specifies the position of the Gripper along the X-axis within the workspace, expressed in millimeters (mm).
Specifies the position of the Gripper along the Y-axis within the workspace, expressed in millimeters (mm).
Specifies the position of the Gripper along the Z-axis within the workspace, expressed in millimeters (mm).
Specifies the designated Cartesian coordinates where the Gripper is positioned to place an object within the workspace.
Specifies the position of the Gripper along the X-axis within the workspace, expressed in millimeters (mm).
Specifies the position of the Gripper along the Y-axis within the workspace, expressed in millimeters (mm).
Specifies the position of the Gripper along the Z-axis within the workspace, expressed in millimeters (mm).
Provides real-time data on the Gripper's current position within the workspace, represented by its coordinates along the X, Y, and Z axes.
Specifies the position of the Gripper along the X-axis within the workspace, expressed in millimeters (mm).
Specifies the position of the Gripper along the Y-axis within the workspace, expressed in millimeters (mm).
Specifies the position of the Gripper along the Z-axis within the workspace, expressed in millimeters (mm).
Provides detailed information and monitoring variables related to the prehensile end effector of the machine.
Specifies the category of the Gripper, such as parallel, angular, vacuum, three-finger, or custom-designed grippers.
Specifies the maximum load or weight that the Gripper is designed to handle safely during operation, expressed in kilograms (kg).
Indicates the current operational status of the gripper, reflecting whether it is in an "Open" or "Closed" state.
